描述_EN: the animal hospital toy range was launched with puppy in my pocket, a successful miniature toy range. animal hospital was a popular bbc series that ran for ten years. the programme was presented by rolf harris, who followed the daily work of vets in a rspca rescue centre. a percentage of the income made from the range goes to the rspca to help them continue their good work with animals. other presenters covered animal stories from around the country and even worldwide. the final series was broadcast in 2002.
描述_ZN: 动物医院的玩具系列与小狗在我的口袋里一起推出，这是一个成功的微型玩具系列。 动物医院是英国广播公司的一个受欢迎的系列节目，持续了10年。 该节目由罗夫-哈里斯主持，他跟随兽医在RSPCA救援中心的日常工作。 该系列玩具的部分收入将捐给RSPCA，以帮助他们继续开展与动物有关的良好工作。 其他主持人报道了来自全国各地甚至全世界的动物故事。 最后一个系列是在2002年播出的。
